name: RPG Map Editor Test
description: GUI test of the RPG map editor on the rpg_demo_game maps of rpg_plus: opens the window, picks a tile in the palette, paints it on the main layer with the mouse, undoes with Ctrl+Z, adds an event by double-clicking on the events layer, and closes without saving (the mod's files stay untouched). Activated by --itest=rpg_editor_edit with --game=rpg_plus --new (the prologue is clicked through first); --shots=<dir> saves screenshots (windowed runs only).
